name: Post Clicked
description: User clicks a post card on the home page or category list. Properties: post_title, post_category, post_slug.

name: Category Filtered
description: User selects a category filter on the home page post list. Properties: category_id, category_name.

name: Article Read
description: User reads to 80%+ of a post article (deep engagement). Properties: post_title, post_category, post_slug, read_time_minutes.

name: Code Block Copied
description: User clicks the Copy button on a code block within a post. Properties: post_slug.

name: Skill Downloaded
description: User downloads a SKILL.md file from the Claude Skills detail page. Properties: skill_title, skill_slug, skill_category.

name: Skill Category Filtered
description: User filters Claude Skills by category. Properties: category.

name: Lobster Message Sent
description: User sends a message in the Ask Lobster chat interface. Properties: message_length, is_suggestion (whether clicked a pre-set suggestion), conversation_turn.

name: Search Opened
description: User opens the search modal via button or Cmd+K shortcut.

name: Search Result Clicked
description: User clicks a result in the search modal. Properties: result_title, result_type, result_category, query_length.

name: Project Link Clicked
description: User clicks a GitHub or demo link on the Code/Projects page. Properties: project_name, link_type (github or demo).
